title: Lesson 16: Observability — Metrics, Logs & Tracing — js-tools
desc: All three pillars hand-written in the app, no library, and three measurements that break habits: with an incident making 1% of requests 300 ms slower, the measured p99 is 0.90 ms — completely blind — while p99.9 is 474 ms and that month's error budget was burned 865%; adding exactly one user_id label makes the number of time series jump from 2 to 49,317 and memory from 330 bytes to 8.4 MB in just 8 seconds; forgetting to propagate the correlation ID doesn't leave you missing data, it gives you WRONG data — 100% of the time blamed on an innocent service while the real culprit eats 45.7%.
